species.name: Crappie
why: Water 64°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–12 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 64°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–12 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
West wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Bluegill
why: Water 64°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–12 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
